entities.name: Grand Calcutron
entities.description: Born Calvin Granderson, a toast-loving inventor who replaced most of his body with machinery and founded and leads the Order of the Widget in Bablovia.

entities.name: Order of the Widget
entities.description: Organization founded by Calvin to support people enhancing themselves with technological implants.

entities.name: Bablovia
entities.description: Place where the Order of the Widget is based.

entities.name: Port Gizmo
entities.description: Place Calvin took a day trip to.

events.summary: Without a toaster on vacation, Calvin builds a portable toaster, then later replaces his left hand with it.
events.quote: This inconvenience inspired him to replace his left hand with his portable toaster

events.summary: Calvin replaces part of his leg with a refrigeration unit and modifies his finger into a butter knife.
events.quote: he modified his right index finger into a butter knife

events.summary: Others in Bablovia adopt similar augmentations, and Calvin founds the Order of the Widget.
events.quote: Calvin established the Order of the Widget.

events.summary: Calvin replaces over 90% of his body with machines and renames himself, finally Grand Calcutron.
events.quote: first to Calcutron Granderson and ultimately to Grand Calcutron

relations.note: Founder and leader for over five decades.
relations.quote: The Grand Calcutron remains the leader of the Order of the Widget
Calvin established the Order of the Widget.
